code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low pH, low oxygen saturation, low pO₂), with mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and hypoalbuminemia. Elevated ferritin, LDH, INR, and monocytes suggest significant inflammation and possible tissue injury. The findings are consistent with acute respiratory failure and systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to severe infection or other critical illness. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are warranted.
